sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct aspect for each situation

items.prompt: Я _____ книгу весь вечер. (I was reading a book all evening.) - ongoing process
items.promptEnglish: I was reading a book all evening. (process)
items.hint: All evening = duration, ongoing process. Which aspect shows process?
items.explanation: Весь вечер (all evening) shows duration. Imperfective читал shows the process.

items.prompt: Она наконец _____ письмо. (She finally finished the letter.) - completed result
items.hint: Наконец (finally) signals a completed result. Она = feminine.
items.explanation: Наконец (finally) signals completion. Perfective написала shows the result.

items.prompt: Каждый день он _____ газету. (Every day he reads the newspaper.) - repetition
items.promptEnglish: Every day he reads the newspaper.
items.hint: Каждый день = every day = repeated action.
items.explanation: Каждый день (every day) = repetition. Imperfective читает for habitual actions.

items.prompt: Мы _____ все задачи. (We solved all the problems.) - completed set
items.explanation: Solving ALL problems = completed result. Perfective решили.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ книгу. (He read/was reading the book.) - he's telling you about the process
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He was reading the book. (process, no mention of finishing)
minimalPairs.explanation: No mention of finishing = focus on the process. Imperfective: читал.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ книгу. (He read/finished the book.) - he's telling you about the result
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He read the book. (finished it, has the result)
minimalPairs.explanation: Focus on result (he finished it). Perfective: прочитал.

minimalPairs.context: Она долго _____ обед. (She cooked lunch for a long time.) - duration
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She cooked lunch for a long time.
minimalPairs.explanation: Долго (for a long time) emphasizes duration. Imperfective: готовила.

minimalPairs.context: Она уже _____ обед. (She already cooked lunch.) - done
minimalPairs.explanation: Уже (already) signals the action is complete. Perfective: приготовила.

blanks: Вчера мы _____ фильм три часа. (Yesterday we watched a movie for three hours.)
Ты уже _____ домашнее задание? (Did you already finish your homework?)
Раньше я часто _____ письма. (I used to write letters often.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing aspect based on context clues
hints: Три часа = duration. Which aspect shows duration?
Уже (already) = completed. Which aspect shows completion?
Часто (often) = repetition. Which aspect shows repetition?
explanations: Три часа (three hours) = duration → imperfective: смотрели.

sets.title: Sort and Recognize
sets.description: Sort verbs by aspect and identify aspect in context

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these verbs: Imperfective (process) or Perfective (result)?

patternRecognition.sentence: весь день, долго, часто, обычно, каждый раз
patternRecognition.question: These time words signal which aspect?
patternRecognition.explanation: Words showing duration (долго, весь день) or repetition (часто, обычно, каждый раз) signal imperfective.

patternRecognition.question: These time words signal which aspect?
patternRecognition.explanation: Words showing completion (уже, наконец) or a sudden single event (вдруг, сразу) signal perfective.

patternRecognition.question: How are these perfective verbs formed from their imperfective pairs?
patternRecognition.explanation: про-читать, на-писать, с-делать, при-готовить: all add a prefix to the imperfective base.

items.prompt: Она вдруг _____ стихотворение. (She suddenly remembered a poem.)
items.explanation: Вдруг (suddenly) signals a single completed action. Perfective: вспомнила.

items.prompt: Я обычно _____ в парке. (I usually walk in the park.)
items.promptEnglish: I usually walk in the park.
items.explanation: Обычно (usually) = repeated/habitual action. Imperfective present: гуляю.

items.prompt: Мы долго _____ эту задачу. (We worked on this problem for a long time.)
items.promptEnglish: We worked on this problem for a long time.
items.hint: Долго (a long time) = duration of process.
items.explanation: Долго (for a long time) = duration. Imperfective: решали.

sets.title: Pairs and Building
sets.description: Match aspect pairs and build sentences with the right aspect
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите видовые пары и составьте предложения

minimalPairs.context: Студенты каждый день _____ новые слова. (Students learn new words every day.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Students learn new words every day. (habitual)
minimalPairs.explanation: Каждый день (every day) = repetition. Imperfective: учат.

minimalPairs.context: Студенты уже _____ все новые слова. (The students already learned all the new words.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The students already learned all the new words. (completed)
minimalPairs.explanation: Уже (already) + все (all) = completed result. Perfective: выучили.

sets.title: Context Clues
sets.description: Use time words and context to pick the right aspect
sets.descriptionRussian: Используйте слова-подсказки для выбора вида глагола

items.promptEnglish: Which word signals an ongoing/repeated action?
items.hint: Which word shows repetition or habit?
items.explanation: Всегда (always) signals habitual/repeated action, which requires imperfective.

items.promptEnglish: Which word signals a completed/single action?
items.hint: Which word implies the action reached its end?
items.explanation: Наконец (finally) implies the action is complete, requiring perfective.

items.prompt: Мама _____ пирог каждое воскресенье. (Mom bakes a pie every Sunday.)
items.promptEnglish: Mom bakes a pie every Sunday.
items.explanation: Каждое воскресенье (every Sunday) = habitual. Imperfective present: печёт.

items.prompt: Он сразу _____ ответ. (He immediately found the answer.)
items.explanation: Сразу (immediately) + a single event = perfective: нашёл.

blanks: Дети целый час _____ уроки. (The children did homework for a whole hour.)
Я уже _____ билеты. (I already bought the tickets.)
Раньше он каждый вечер _____ в парке. (He used to jog in the park every evening.)
Она наконец _____ работу. (She finally finished the work.)
hints: Целый час (a whole hour) = duration = imperfective.
explanations: Каждый вечер = habitual repetition. Imperfective: бегал.

errorCorrection.sentence: Я уже прочитал эту книгу каждый день.
errorCorrection.hint: Каждый день (every day) requires imperfective, not perfective.
errorCorrection.explanation: Каждый день = repetition, which requires imperfective: читал, not прочитал.

errorCorrection.hint: Долго (for a long time) shows duration, not result.
errorCorrection.explanation: Долго = duration of process = imperfective: готовила, not приготовила.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A final round testing all aspect concepts together
sets.descriptionRussian: Финальный раунд: все аспекты вида глагола

items.hint: Think of the ongoing nature of imperfective verbs.
items.explanation: Imperfective (НСВ) expresses process, duration, and repetition: things happening, not finished.

items.prompt: Вчера я _____ три статьи. (Yesterday I wrote three articles.) - all three completed
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday I wrote three articles. (all completed)
items.hint: Three completed articles = result. Male speaker.
items.explanation: Three completed articles = quantified result. Perfective: написал.

items.prompt: Когда я _____, зазвонил телефон. (While I was reading, the phone rang.)
items.promptEnglish: While I was reading, the phone rang.
items.hint: Background action interrupted by another event = imperfective.
items.explanation: Background ongoing action = imperfective: читал. The phone ringing was the perfective event.

items.prompt: Она _____ торт и позвала гостей. (She baked a cake and called the guests.)
items.promptEnglish: She baked a cake and then called the guests. (sequential completed events)
items.hint: Two sequential completed events (baked, then called).
items.explanation: Sequential completed actions in a chain = perfective: испекла, then позвала.

errorCorrection.sentence: Каждый день она написала письмо маме.
errorCorrection.hint: Каждый день = every day = habitual repetition.
errorCorrection.explanation: Каждый день (every day) = habitual repetition = imperfective: писала.

errorCorrection.hint: Наконец (finally) signals the action was completed.
errorCorrection.explanation: Наконец (finally) = completion = perfective: решил, not решал.

errorCorrection.sentence: Вчера весь день я сделал домашнее задание.
errorCorrection.hint: Весь день (all day) = duration, not a single completed moment.
errorCorrection.explanation: Весь день = duration = imperfective: делал. Perfective сделал would mean a single moment of completing.
